aiVerification.summary: Comparable Normal vs test Suspension A/B evidence exists, but the draft grouping and outcomes are incomplete.
issues: Changed factor is filename-like and leaves baseline/test explicit conditions unset.
Most result domains are omitted: assy/frame NG, spot welding, and function.
Tension outcome grouping does not clearly separate A/B and normal/test rows.
Subgroup keys such as date, line, process, and suspension type are missing.
Decision and result-note rows are not fully used.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal vs Test Suspension 201506-A/B from new vendor WorldTop Hanoi Vina first lot.
Set baseline as Normal and changed condition as Test Suspension A/B, with A and B as subgroup/type context.
Add outcomes for assy/frame NG, spot welding before/after repair, function NG, and tension.
Preserve subgroup keys including date, line, check type, process section, and suspension A/B.
Add supporting result and decision citations from rows 30, 39, 46, and 49-53.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations are citeable but insufficient for final evidence until missing outcome and decision rows are added.
